essence: The whole path fixed through door-to-image in consciousness; melting path-body-breath-mind-void, full-consciousness attained; the beyond-portion offered — hence prakriyā-knowledge-endowed is required.
The knowledge that is prakriyā's end is not prakriyā itself.
Earth-tattva: hundred-crore-extended, brahmāṇḍa-form.
Within it: Kālāgni, hells, pātālas, earth, heaven to Brahma-world.
Outside the egg, a hundred Rudras.
The eggs themselves: uncountable.
Water from earth, tenfold.
Successive tenfold to ahaṃkāra's end.
The five-substance, eleven-wombed formula: water, fire, wind, sky, ahaṃkāra — and so.
Buddhi from ahaṃkāra, hundredfold.
Prakṛti thousandfold — the prakṛtyaṇḍa.
The prakṛti-egg: countless, like the cosmic-egg.
Puruṣa from prakṛti, ten-thousandfold.
Niyati from persons, lakh-fold.
Ten-lakh-fold successive to kalā's end.
Niyati's formula: niyati, rāga, aśuddha-vidyā, kāla, kalā.
Māyā crorefold from kalā — the māyāṇḍa.
Śuddhavidyā ten-crore-multiplied from māyā.
Īśvara hundred-crore-fold from vidyā.
Sādākhya thousand-crore-fold from īśvara.
Śakti multiplied-by-group from sādākhya — the śaktyaṇḍa.
Power pervades the world-path inside-outside — hence all-pervading.
Tattvas stand as mutual-coverings: later pervader, earlier pervaded.
The path pervaded by Śiva-tattva to the all-power-end.
Śiva-tattva: immeasurable, beyond all paths, pervading all.
Bhuvanas dwell in tattva-gaps; their lords stand in earth.
Those dying in those abodes: their course granted.
Successively upward-downward impelled, by dīkṣā-order.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta-śānta of a cosmos counted (wonder at multiplication landing)
rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya-śama (wonder at the ladder, settling into bhuvana-grant)
rasa.justification: The relish is scale itself — each ×10 or ×10⁶ lands like a struck bell; śānta is the count's calm; the closing gati-grant turns inventory into motion.

sections.FUNCTION: Fixes the path in consciousness, then builds the tattva-cosmology by multiplication-ladder (10×…10¹¹×) to Śiva-tattva, and closes with bhuvana-lords granting gati by dīkṣā-order.
sections.KEY TERMS: adhvan (path, deśa to liṅga); melting-sequence (path-body-prāṇa-mind-void); tattva-ladder (tenfold/hundredfold/…multiplicands); āvaraṇa-hierarchy (later covers earlier); śaktyaṇḍa/māyāṇḍa (egg-counts); bhuvana-lords (gati-granters); dīkṣā-krama (the cycle's motor).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 7 follows the prakriyā-jñāna declaration (u1-2); the cosmology feeds the worship-target lists of later āhṇikas.
sections.BOUNDARY: Multiplicands stated as printed (some odd: puruṣa 10,000×); egg-counts declared countless, not estimated; bhuvana-gati attributed to lords, no soteriology argued here.
sections.EXPLANATION: The chapter answers 'where does the path stand' twice: first phenomenologically (melting inward until full-consciousness), then cosmologically (the tattva-ladder with recursive tenfold-multiplication and egg-counts). Each tattva both covers the prior and is covered by the next (āvaraṇa), until Śiva-tattva transcends and pervades all. The bhuvana-lords then operationalize the ladder: they grant dying-grounds and drive ūrdhva/ūrdhva motion by dīkṣā-order — cosmology as engine, not inventory.
sections.RELATED: Tantrāloka tattva-list parallels; Śivopaniṣad (u1-2 formula); qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.
